findings.text: For darwin arm64, versions 14.17.0 through 14.x no longer fall back to x64, but the new comment says no binaries exist before v16. `nvm install 14.17.0` on an M1 Mac now requests a `darwin-arm64` tarball that doesn't exist. The download 404s, and nvm then falls back to a source build instead of the x64 binary that worked before.
